name: ARTful Puzzles
summary:
Relax and immerse yourself in the exciting world of art. Collect jigsaw puzzles featuring iconic works by the most famous artists.

In our collection of puzzles, you will find carefully selected paintings by artists from different eras, genres and countries. Thanks to the great detail of the images, you can pay attention to the smallest details of the paintings and discover the author's ideas in a new light.

Key features:
- Puzzles of various shapes and a wide range of difficulty levels
- High-quality scan
